summary: A steel leg-hold trap with toothed jaws: two half-ring jaws on pins between two posts lie open round a round… joints pan, dog, jaw_front, jaw_back, spring_r, spring_l; options finish, chain.
setup: Spawn it with Prefabs.bear_trap or place "prefab": "bear_trap" in a scene; Game(plugins=[...]) needs physics3d().
